description: Under Richard Woolsey's leadership, Atlantis deals with the aftermath of Michael's campaign, new Ancient-era threats and an increasingly unstable Wraith balance before a super-hive carries the conflict directly to Earth.

s05e01.description: Sheppard's team searches the ruins of Michael's collapsed facility for Teyla and the missing expedition members while Michael races to escape with her child.

s05e02.description: Keller becomes infected by a Wraith-derived organism that begins transforming her and spreading organic growth through Atlantis.

s05e03.description: Ronon's former friend Tyre returns under Wraith influence and drags him into the same enzyme addiction that once controlled Ford.

s05e04.description: The team finds an apparently abandoned Daedalus that jumps uncontrollably between alternate realities, each presenting a different way to die.

s05e05.description: Replicator consciousnesses claiming to include Elizabeth Weir seize technology in Atlantis and ask for help finding bodies in which they can survive.

s05e06.description: A parasite causes McKay to lose his memories and abilities with frightening speed, leaving his friends one narrow chance to restore him.

s05e07.description: Sheppard and Beckett join an all-female field team investigating one of Michael's abandoned laboratories, where his failed experiments are still alive.

s05e08.description: Teyla impersonates a Wraith queen to help Todd negotiate an alliance, forcing her to command a hive while maintaining the deception.

s05e09.description: Keller is abducted from a village by a Wraith Runner, sending McKay and Ronon after a man whose motives are not what they first appear.

s05e10.description: Daniel Jackson visits Atlantis to investigate Janus's hidden laboratory and uncovers a secretive advanced race with its own plan for defeating the Wraith.

s05e11.description: The stolen Attero device begins destroying active Stargates across Pegasus while Daniel and McKay learn the identity and history of their captors.

s05e12.description: A village shelters refugees carrying the Hoffan anti-Wraith treatment and faces annihilation when a hive demands that the outsiders be surrendered.

s05e13.description: A coalition of Pegasus worlds puts the Atlantis expedition on trial for actions that have altered the balance of power across the galaxy.

s05e14.description: Michael infiltrates Atlantis and takes control of the city in a final attempt to seize Teyla and her child.

s05e15.description: An Ancient-era object recovered from the ocean produces convincing hallucinations while Woolsey confronts an IOA challenge to his command.

s05e16.description: McKay takes Keller to a scientific conference on Earth where a demonstration intended to combat global warming threatens a catastrophic atmospheric event.

s05e17.description: Todd's hive arrives crippled by a failed gene treatment, forcing Atlantis to help a Wraith crew whose ship is literally falling apart around them.

s05e18.description: An alien consciousness exchange leaves Keller trapped in the body of a wanted thief while the criminal uses Keller's body inside Atlantis.

s05e19.description: In an alternate reality, detective John Sheppard investigates a string of killings in Las Vegas that leads to a Wraith hiding on Earth.

s05e20.description: A Wraith super-hive powered by ZPMs learns Earth's location, forcing Atlantis into a final pursuit that brings the city and the war to the Milky Way.
